title: Atlassian API token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: "!" at byte 24, outside the [A-Za-z0-9_-] body alphabet, leaving under 100 contiguous body characters. Twin of "Atlassian API token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
